prompt: Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. Pure white background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One small round cake with one broad frosting edge and one big candle, no writing. Show only the specified object itself: no person, child, hands or scene around it.
